Control Objective: Ensure user accounts are protected with MFA
Test Procedure: Review MFA settings and verify coverage for user accounts

Control Objective: Ensure user access is reviewed regularly
Expected Evidence: Access review report and reviewer approval
Test Procedure: Verify quarterly review completion and evidence of remediation

Control Objective: Ensure administrator access is limited and reviewed
Expected Evidence: Privileged account inventory and approval records
Test Procedure: Review privileged accounts and confirm recurring access reviews

Control Objective: Ensure security events are centrally collected
Test Procedure: Verify critical systems are sending logs to centralized monitoring

Control Objective: Ensure security alerts are reviewed and escalated
Test Procedure: Sample alerts and verify investigation and escalation documentation

Control Objective: Ensure the organization maintains documented incident procedures
Test Procedure: Review the current incident response plan for required procedures

Expected Evidence: Tabletop exercise report and lessons learned
Test Procedure: Verify an incident response exercise was completed within the review period

Control Objective: Ensure employees receive recurring security training
Test Procedure: Review employee training records and verify completion

Control Objective: Ensure systems are regularly scanned for vulnerabilities
Test Procedure: Review scan frequency and confirm critical systems are included

Control Objective: Ensure vulnerabilities are remediated within defined timelines
Test Procedure: Sample vulnerabilities and compare closure dates against remediation targets

Control Objective: Ensure critical systems and data are backed up
Expected Evidence: Backup job logs and backup policy
Test Procedure: Review backup schedule and verify successful backup jobs

Control Objective: Ensure backups can be successfully restored
Test Procedure: Verify documented restoration testing was performed

Control Objective: Ensure critical vendors are assessed for security risk
Test Procedure: Review a sample vendor assessment and verify documented approval

Control Objective: Ensure terminated users lose access promptly
Expected Evidence: Termination record and account disablement log
Test Procedure: Compare termination time with account disablement time

Control Objective: Ensure firewall rules are periodically reviewed
Test Procedure: Verify recurring firewall reviews and documented changes
